name: llama.cpp Metal on M5 Max (40 GPU): Llama-2-7B f16 tg128 tok/s (scoreboard #4167, c1d0e7a)
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #4167, ggerganov-maintained). llama-bench -hf ggml-org/Llama-2-7B-GGUF -p 512 -n 128 -ngl 99 --delay 30, Metal backend (MTL,BLAS), full GPU offload, 6 threads.
